head: ṣmm (to be dirty/make dirty, to soil )
notes:
uʕdo kǝmṣamamno i maṣa;
ramḥǝl gǝmṣamamno aǧ ǧulayḏi;

aṯmǝl mṣamamli u bayto.
Mṣamamli aǧ ǧulayḏi. ‘I made my clothes dirty.’(İlyas p.c)
Mṣamamli ruḥi.’I made myself dirty.’ (İlyas p.c)

U ṣemomo du bayto komaʕaǧazli ġalabe.  (İlyas p.c)
U ṣemomo du lešono pistǝr me kul ṣemomo yo. (İlyas p.c)

Aǧ ǧulayḏi mǝd komiṣammi koʕoǧazno ġalabe. (İlyas p.c)
U lešono komišamam max xabre pise. ʻThe language is become dirty because of bad words.’(İlyas p.c)

Lišoni bere ġalabe mṣammowa. (İlyas p.c)
Aṯmǝl i ḥolo mṣamamtowa ġalabe. (İlyas p.c)
